clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Old Town, Jasper Fel supplies daggers and vials from SI:7 headquarters. He keeps watch on visitors and warns them to mind their speech.

Inside SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Jasper Fel supplies the agents who work there. He offers simple daggers and empty vials for brewing and applying poisons. Jasper works under Mathias Shaw's intelligence division and warns visitors to mind their speech. In a place built for espionage, careless words can put people in danger.
